description:
x.f(a...) whose base is not a module name is a call on a module value (a field read stays a field read). Body lowering emits a DirectCall whose callee is DirectCallee::ModuleValue { module, function }; the module is evaluated before the arguments. Semantic resolves from the receiver's type (resolve_module_value_call): the type must be within atom and list its atoms; each atom goes through ModuleName::from_atom_name -> World::reference_module -> World::module_public_function (the lookup Mod.f(...) resolution shares). One atom -> a direct call; several -> one target per atom, chosen at run time.

As built, the receiver is not an argument and no surface grows to arity n+1. Each CallTargetSummary carries selector: Option<Ty>, the atom of its module. Dispatch surfaces are selector ++ surface inputs (callsite_dispatch::target_surfaces, CallSiteSummary::arity), and BackendTail::DirectCall.selector is prepended to the dispatch inputs in native and the interpreter, so arguments stay one-for-one with the callee's inputs. Keying asks the module value whole (two module receivers keep two keys, each a direct call); the dispatch demand reads its choice from the module (CallsiteDispatchDemand.selector).

Refused at compile time with type/module-value-call: a receiver that is never an atom, one that is only sometimes an atom, one typed plain atom (lists no modules; fz-3sy.5 removes this refusal and decides the mixed case), and an atom outside Elixir. such as :erlang (ModuleName::from_atom_name maps only Elixir.-prefixed atoms; fz-sc8.3 adds the rest). An undefined module or function reuses resolve/unknown-module and resolve/unknown-import.

Removed direct_callee's field-read-then-closure-call fallback for a call on a bound base. Fixtures 00864-00867; e.__struct__.f(e) works on all three paths.
title: A call on a module value: one atom or a finite set of atoms
